text:
maria: Draft for v1.12 release notes is up — need a quick sweep for SDK snippets, link fixes, and known issues. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/3892

jen_c: I can run snippets migration tomorrow morning. Which SDKs should be prioritized? Python + Go first.

samg: I'll scan for broken anchors and redirects. Found 3 old embed links already.

alexr: @jen_c can you also add the new 'session pinning' example? Tiny snippet:
```
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(..., session_pin=True)
```

ira: Noting a known issue with streaming in Dedicated when sequence > 8k tokens — add to known issues list.

docs-bot: Draft PR #3892 created -> https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/3892 :eyes:

jen_c: ack. I'll push a Python sample and a Go stub before EOD.

kevin: Heads up — marketing also wants the short release blurb by Friday. Can we have a one-paragraph commit?

maria: Yes, I'll write the blurb once snippets are in. @samg, can you drop the link list in the PR comments when done?

samg: will do. I'll also open quick redirects for the 2 anchors that 404.

deploy-bot: Preview build passed 🎉 — https://redwood-docs-preview.netlify.app/pr-3892

jen_c: pushed Python example. Go example WIP, leaving TODO with TODO_COMMIT tag.

ira: Added known-issue note to PR about streaming latency; flagged for triage.

maria: Great. Plan: snippets + link fixes today, blurb tomorrow AM, final sign-off before EOD Friday. If anything blocks, ping here. :thumbsup:
